title: GOLD EPB-EIA Detection: Automatic Detection and Segmentation of Equatorial Ionospheric Irregularities
description: This repository provides data processing, deep learning model training, prediction, and evaluation codes for the automatic detection and segmentation of equatorial plasma bubbles (EPBs) and equatorial ionization anomalies (EIAs) from GOLD airglow observations. The repository includes implementations based on U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and Feature Pyramid Network (FPN). The associated annotated GOLD airglow image dataset is publicly available on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22705373.
